title: Machine learning guides fatty acyl-ACP reductase engineering
summary: A machine-learning-guided iterative design–test–learn workflow engineered fatty acyl-ACP reductase variants for microbial fatty alcohol production. Across ten rounds, the study reports over twice the production of the starting natural sequences under tested conditions; the top sequence also had enhanced catalytic rate on palmitoyl-ACP. These are laboratory results, not industrial-scale production. The journal article date is used here; the earlier preprint’s exact posting and result-version differences were not checked.

source_review.scope: Primary Nature Communications indexed full text, abstract, article date, author affiliations; preprint chronology not fully checked.

evidence.tested: The paper reports ten design–test–learn rounds, in-vivo microbial fatty-alcohol production and catalytic-rate characterization on palmitoyl-ACP.
evidence.unknown: Results are under the study’s microbial test conditions and do not establish industrial production; exact preprint-version results remain unchecked.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning models iteratively selected reductase sequences for experimental testing and subsequent model updates.
